```{r cars}
library(tidyverse)
tx_info <- read_tsv("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/004_alignment/all_plates_96w/mapping_bias/transcripts.bed",
                    col_names = c("chrom","start","end","gene_id","score","strand", "feature"),
                    show_col_types = FALSE)
head(tx_info)

# Get gene length
tx_info <- tx_info %>%
  mutate(tx_length = end - start)

# Load reads BED
bed <- read_tsv("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/004_alignment/all_plates_96w/300167_S180Aligned.toTranscriptome.out.bed",
                col_names = c("gene_id","read_start","read_end","read_name","score","strand"),
                show_col_types = FALSE)


bed_joined <- bed %>%
  left_join(tx_info %>% select(gene_id, tx_length, strand),
            by = "gene_id") %>%
  mutate(dist_to_3prime = tx_length - read_start)

head(bed_joined)
bed_joined <- na.omit(bed_joined)
bed_joined %>% 
  #filter(gene_id == "AT5TE20395" &  score==255)%>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = dist_to_3prime)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = "steelblue", color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-100, 3000)) +
  labs(
    title = "Distance of reads to 3' end",
    x = "Distance to 3' end (bp)",
    y = "Number of reads"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

```


```{r}
## Check 3' bias for anti-sense TEs (claimed to be anti-sense)
library(dplyr)

# Load transcripts
tx <- read_tsv("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/004_alignment/all_plates_96w/mapping_bias/transcripts.bed",
                    col_names = c("chrom","tx_start","tx_end","tx_id","score","strand", "feature"),
                    show_col_types = FALSE)
# Load reads (transcriptome coordinates)
reads <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/004_alignment/all_plates_96w/mapping_bias/294324_S11.toTranscriptome.out.bed", header = FALSE,col.names = c("tx_id", "start", "end", "read_id", "score", "strand")) %>%
  mutate(mid = (start + end) / 2)
```
# Sense and anti-sense distribution
```{r}
merged <- reads %>%
  inner_join(tx, by = "tx_id")
```

```{r}
merged <- reads %>%
  inner_join(select(tx, tx_id, tx_start, tx_end, strand), by="tx_id") %>%
  mutate(
    tx_len      = tx_end - tx_start,   # genomic length = transcript length ✓
    dist_5prime = mid,                  # mid is already in transcript coords (0=5')
    dist_3prime = tx_len - mid,         # distance from 3' end
    rel_pos     = mid / tx_len          # 0=5', 1=3'
  ) 

merged$feature <- ifelse(grepl("TE", merged$tx_id), "TE", "gene")

merged_long <- merged %>%
  dplyr::select(feature, dist_5prime,rel_pos, dist_3prime) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -feature,
               names_to  = "metric",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(metric = recode(metric,
    "dist_5prime" = "Dist from 5'",
    "rel_pos"="rel_pos",
    "dist_3prime" = "Dist from 3'"))

ggplot(merged_long, aes(x = value, fill = metric)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Dist from 5'"          = "seagreen",
    "Dist from 3'"          = "tomato",
    "rel_pos"=="blue"
  )) +
  facet_grid(feature ~ metric, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Read distribution relative to gene ends",
       x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

## Calculate over all files
```{r}

library(tidyverse)

bed_dir <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/004_alignment/all_plates_96w/mapping_bias/"

# Load transcript annotation once
tx <- read_tsv(file.path(bed_dir, "transcripts.bed"),
               col_names = c("chrom","tx_start","tx_end","tx_id","score","strand","feature"),
               show_col_types = FALSE)

# Get all toTranscriptome BED files
bed_files <- list.files(bed_dir, pattern = "\\.toTranscriptome\\.out\\.bed$", full.names = TRUE)


# Pre-key tx once
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(furrr)

# Set up parallel workers (use available cores - 1)
library(progressr)

plan(multisession, workers = max(1, parallelly::availableCores() - 1))

tx_sub <- select(tx, tx_id, tx_start, tx_end, strand)

with_progress({
  p <- progressor(steps = length(bed_files))
  
  all_results <- future_imap_dfr(bed_files, function(f, i) {
    sample_id <- sub("_.*", "", basename(f))
    p(sprintf("Processing %s [%d/%d]", sample_id, i, length(bed_files)))
    
    fread(f, col.names = c("tx_id", "start", "end", "read_id", "score", "strand")) %>%
      mutate(mid = (start + end) / 2) %>%
      inner_join(tx_sub, by = "tx_id") %>%
      filter(strand.x == strand.y) %>%
      mutate(
        sample_id   = sample_id,
        dist_5prime = if_else(strand.y == "+", mid - tx_start, tx_end - mid),
        dist_3prime = if_else(strand.y == "+", tx_end - mid,   mid - tx_start),
        rel_pos     = dist_5prime / (tx_end - tx_start)
      ) %>%
      filter(rel_pos >= 0, rel_pos <= 1) %>%
      select(sample_id, tx_id, read_id, strand.y, dist_5prime, dist_3prime, rel_pos)
  })
})

plan(sequential)
plan(sequential)  # res
# Save
write_tsv(all_results, file.path(bed_dir, "all_samples_read_distances.tsv"))
```
